How to Play

The controls are direct: pull strength, pull angle, and leading the hoop are the skill.

1

Grab the Ball

Start the gesture on the basketball itself. The neutral shot begins centered; moving hoops never drag your aim around automatically.

2

Pull

Touch the basketball and drag backward. Pull distance maps directly to launch power. Pull angle leads left/right and also changes the arc: straighter pulls are steeper, wider pulls are flatter. The highlighted band is only a reference.

3

Release & Lead

Release when the pull strength and angle look right. In moving modes, pull opposite the direction you want the ball to travel and lead where the hoop will be when the shot arrives.
